concerns.text: The plan defines functional requirement identifiers FR‑001 … FR‑012, but the specification document (spec.md) does not declare any FR identifiers. This breaks the Plan ↔ Specification linkage required for traceability.

Only the descriptor and model‑output contracts are referenced in the plan, yet the project includes many other contract schemas (e.g., dataset.schema.yaml, elemental_properties.schema.yaml, hea_composition.schema.yaml). No plan step mentions validation against these contracts, violating the Plan ↔ Contracts consistency rule.
The download_data phase should reference the `contracts/dataset.schema.yaml` to validate the raw Matbench HEA dataset, but the plan omits any contract‑validation step for the raw dataset.
